findings.message: Proposed end-of-life (2027-04-16) exceeds the EOL cap cutoff (2027-01-16) by 3 months. The app part sources from https://github.com/canonical/demo-rock with source-tag v1.2.1, making this an upstream-sourced application subject to §2 EOL cap. No accepted support plan is available per context.md:12. Revise the EOL date to 2027-01-16 or earlier, or request human acceptance of a support plan in CODEOWNERS.

summary: Patch version update from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1 with app source-tag changed from v1.2.0 to v1.2.1. No changes to parts structure, services, build/stage packages, or scripts. Recipe comparison is complete; evidence confirms no behavioral changes.
